web.title: Your server
web.hint: Drag channels to reorder them, click a name to rename it (emoji, separator, font). Nothing is sent to Discord before “Review and apply”.
web.applied: Applied: {roles} roles, {created} created, {renamed} renamed, {moved} moved, {removed} deleted.

summary.title: Summary of changes
summary.confirm: I confirm deleting {count} channel(s) and their messages.

errors.module_disabled: Turn the module on to apply changes.
errors.missing_permissions: Kron can't manage some channels. Part of the changes may have been applied.
errors.too_many_channels: Discord limits a server to 500 channels.
errors.unknown_channel: A channel changed meanwhile. The page was reloaded.
errors.discord_error: Discord refused part of the changes. The page was reloaded.
errors.unknown_role: A chosen role no longer exists. The page was reloaded.
errors.remove_not_confirmed: Tick the confirmation to delete channels.

beautify.title: ✨ Beautify names
beautify.hint: Give every channel and category the same style: an emoji (kept when there is one, otherwise picked from the name), a separator and a font. The result shows in the tree below; nothing reaches Discord before “Review and apply”, and “Cancel” at the bottom puts everything back.
beautify.previewed: Preview applied to the tree. Review it, then apply or cancel.
beautify.addEmojis: Add an emoji to names that have none
beautify.addEmojisHint: Picked from the name: rules → 📜, tickets → 🎫, general → 💬…
beautify.backup: The original names of {count} channel(s) can be restored until {until}.
beautify.restored: {count} channel(s) got their previous name back.
beautify.restoreSkipped: {count} channel(s) are out of Kron’s reach and kept their name.

packs.title: 📦 Server packs
packs.hint: Add ready-made categories, channels and roles for your kind of server in one click. They join the tree above: what already exists (same name) is kept, nothing is deleted. Rename or remove anything, then “Review and apply”. 🔒 categories are private: only their roles and Kron see them.
packs.added: Pack added to the tree. Review, adjust, then apply or cancel.

fivem.name: FiveM RP server

streamer.hint: Live announcements, clips, fan art, a private lounge for VIPs and subscribers, watch party.

community.name: Community
community.hint: Welcome, introductions, roles, events, polls, support and voice.

locked.access: Kron cannot see or manage this channel: it cannot rename it.
locked.counter: A channel stats counter names this channel itself.
locked.note: {count} channel(s) are hidden from Kron (🔒): it cannot rename or move them. To include them, add the Kron role to those channels or their category (View Channel + Manage Channels), then reload this page.
